messages:
SRE Pager: :rotating_light: paging oncall — high error rate from hosted runtime in US-WEST, spike in GPU OOMs tied to KV cache growth. Seeing continuous-batching churn.
Oncall Bot: Incident created INC-2026-045 and routed to #incidents and oncall. Pager notes: 17 hosts reporting OOMs, average request latency > 3s.
Alice L.: Observed single-tenant long prompt stream causing KV window to grow unbounded. Likely runaway 1.2M token prefix in a few requests. Traces show KV size ramping before OOMs.
Samir: Which model / runtime?
Alice L.: Hosted runtime: rdx-gpu-v2, model variant r-instruct-13b-8q. Continuous batching enabled with max_window=65536 and prefix_cache retention=keep.
Irina K.: Customer impact: two enterprise customers reported 5xxs and high latency; we see ~2% increase in 500s on api-hosted-prod. Potentially broader but self-healing once nodes reboot.
Marta: Starting mitigation checklist from runbook: 1) disable continuous batching globally for hosted runtime, 2) reduce max_batch_window to 4096, 3) evict large KV entries older than X, 4) scale up fallback CPU pool. Applying 1 now.
DevOps: Copying commands. Marta — do you want a rolling restart or config push?
Marta: Config push first (hot reload), then rolling restart of nodes that still exceed memory threshold.
Oncall Bot: Applying patch: runtime-config set continuous_batching=false --scope hosted --env prod
SRE Pager: Patch applied on control plane. Observability: dropping QPS on batcher threads by ~60% and immediate reduction in KV growth on 6/8 hosts.
Samir: Still seeing two hosts with memory climb — will force eviction on those. Running: 
```
ssh root@host-122
curl -XPOST http://localhost:9000/kv/evict?threshold=200MB
```
Alice L.: Eviction triggered; KV sizes on host-122 and host-127 fell from ~18GB to ~1.2GB. OOMs stopped there.
Customer Success: Reached out to affected customers, letting them know we're mitigating; one asked for play-by-play.
Irina K.: Root cause hypothesis: a small subset of requests containing very long concatenated system messages bypassed prefix-length checks and kept getting appended to prefix cache due to continuous batcher merge logic. Issue introduced in last runtime release (runt-2026-02-15) where merge_throttle bug allowed unlimited prefix_merge.
Marta: Hotfix plan: revert merge_throttle change and release a patch tomorrow. For immediate safety we will: 1) keep continuous batching disabled, 2) enforce per-request prefix limit 250k tokens at API gateway, 3) add defensive eviction path when KV > 4GB per model instance.
DevOps: Pushing APIGW rule: 
```
rdx-apigw set-rate-limit --route /v1/generate --prefix-token-limit 250000
```
Oncall Bot: APIGW rule active in prod with 95% rollout.
SRE Pager: Telemetry update: 500 error rate down to baseline in last 12m, tail latency improved. Still monitoring for regressions.
Samir: Preparing post-incident tasks: 1) backfill missing telemetry for prefix lengths, 2) write regression test to send long prompt spike, 3) correlate user IDs to requests and inform CS for follow-up.
Alice L.: Adding note — we found several internal retrying clients that re-submitted the same long prompt repeatedly; added guard in gateway to dedupe identical payloads within 60s.
Marta: Handoff to next oncall in 30m. Next oncall: Irina K. You'll own follow-ups and the rollback plan timeline.
Irina K.: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate hotfix deploy window with ENG-RUNTIME and patch revert with QA.
DevOps: Scheduled rolling restart of 17 affected hosts at 02:30 UTC to pick up eviction and config changes; will do 2 hosts at a time.
Customer Success: Notifying customers of recovery and letting them know we will follow up with a detailed incident report and mitigation timeline.
SRE Pager: Summary: immediate mitigation successful (disable continuous batching, APIGW prefix limit, targeted eviction). Medium-term: patch revert and tighter KV guards. No data loss. Impact: transient 5xxs and elevated latency for ~27 minutes, affecting a handful of enterprise customers.
Marta: Adding postmortem owners: Alice L. (root cause + logs), Samir (runtime fix), Irina K. (oncall handoff and customer comms), DevOps (deployment plan).
Oncall Bot: Handoff: next_oncall=Irina K., handoff_ts=1769005620.
Irina K.: I'll take it. Will start drafting incident timeline and action items.
SRE Pager: Closing live mitigation channel — will keep thread open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
